description: JStock is open showing the Stock Watchlist with only 'My Watchlist' available. Your task is to create a new watchlist named 'Dividend Stocks'. To create a new watchlist: go to the Watchlist menu in the menu bar, select 'Multiple Watchlists...', then in the dialog that opens, click the 'New...' button, enter 'Dividend Stocks' as the name in the input prompt, and click OK. The new 'Dividend Stocks' watchlist should then appear in the Watchlist menu alongside 'My Watchlist'.
